description: Generate subject line variants for an A/B test from a prompt. Returns suggestions only and does not create or change a test; the first generation for a company also saves its inferred email design direction, which later generations reuse.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

topic.description: Topic or context for the subject lines

name: generate_subject_lines

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `generate_subject_lines` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

variants.description: List of generated subject line variant records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
